neighbours.label: names of instant-messaging / chat services and protocols (Kik, XMPP, LINE, Hangouts, WhatsApp, 'chat' as a messaging service), not other apps, sites or network protocols
fire: Message me on Kik if you want to talk tonight.
The office moved its group conversations from Skype to an XMPP server.
Most of my cousins send voice notes over WhatsApp or Kik.

The plugin lets a Jabber or XMPP account log in from the desktop.
Add me on Kik or Snapchat and we can talk there.
Support staff answer questions through web chat and Facebook Messenger.
